chunks: And Ibn Mahbub narrated from ʿAli ibn Riʾab from Abu ʿAbdillah عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who placed his slave on a riding animal, and it trampled a man, he عليه السلام said: "The liability is upon the master."

key_terms.عَبْدًا: a slave owned by the master
key_terms.ٱلْغُرْمُ: financial liability or compensation due for harm
key_terms.ٱلْمَوْلَى: the master or owner responsible in this case

ai.seo_question: Who bears liability if a slave on an animal causes a person to be trampled?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about liability when harm is caused in a situation involving a slave and an animal. Imam Abu ʿAbdillah عليه السلام states that the financial compensation falls upon the master.
